description: Rubric bank for ConvoDojo feedback. Rubrics are LENSES, not verdicts: every dimension anchors to utterance-level evidence; scores are directional practice signals. Auto-coded scores (Han 2026 ~52.6% accuracy) are inputs requiring evidence anchoring.

dimensions.metric: share of questions that are open
share of reflections that are complex (add meaning)
dimensions.note: Aimi: 66.7% complex reflections is a strong reference; not a hard bar
Aimi reference 0.84; below 0.5 signals interrogative drift

dimensions.metric: sustain talk met with reflection, not argument
dimensions.note: MI spirit: never argue against resistance
MI without spirit is not MI

dimensions.metric: reflection quality at high pressure levels

rubric_use_rules: rubrics are lenses: scores anchor to quotes, never standalone
no rubric score becomes a verdict about the user as a person
rubric selection matches practice_target; provisional rubrics are marked provisional
debrief template (debrief_template.md) consumes rubric output with evidence sections
